article.title: ‘Once Upon a Time in Harlem’ film review: A must-see on Black history, arts, and politics
article.author: Ed Rampell
article.content: The Harlem Renaissance was a Black awakening in the arts, politics, fashion, etc., during circa the 1920s/1930s that, decades before the “Black Power” and “Black is Beautiful” movements, heralded the advent of “the New Negro.” The post ‘Once Upon a Time in Harlem’ film review: A must-see on Black history, arts, and politics appeared first on MR Online .
